title: Exact fulfillment policy manual-approval requirement decision
purpose: Represent one immutable caller-supplied trusted-policy decision declaring whether one exact FOOD-005E physical-order and FOOD-005D fulfillment-intent snapshot requires separate manual fulfillment approval before later checkout/payment readiness may be considered.
whyNow: Canonical business direction requires explicit manual approval for some fulfillment requests before charging.
FOOD-005M records positive manual approval evidence but does not decide which requests require that approval.
No canonical policy decision currently distinguishes fulfillment requests that require FOOD-005M from those that do not.
A general payment-readiness projection would otherwise have to require FOOD-005M for every order or guess when approval is required.

contract.identity: Caller-supplied food-fulfillment-policy-decision identity. Initial version is exactly 1.
contract.orderBinding: Bind one exact FOOD-005E physical-order ID/version.
contract.fulfillmentBinding: Bind the exact FOOD-005D fulfillment-intent ID/version and exact method/locationReference/windowReference snapshot associated with that order version.
contract.policyMeaning: The decision is caller-supplied trusted-policy evidence only. This pure domain does not calculate geography, radius, distance, eligibility or fees.
contract.notRequiredMeaning: not-required means the trusted policy source says a separate FOOD-005M manual approval is not required for this exact fulfillment snapshot. It does not mean inside service area and does not create checkout/payment readiness.
contract.requiredMeaning: required means a separate positive FOOD-005M approval must later be supplied before downstream readiness may treat the manual-approval gate as satisfied. Required is not itself approval.
contract.provenance: Caller supplies attribution, opaque policyReference and decidedOn. The pure domain does not authenticate the policy source.
contract.historicalCancellation: A policy decision may remain historical evidence against an exact cancelled physical-order version and does not revive it.
contract.immutability: Strict own-key allowlists with detached frozen result and nested snapshots.
contract.purity: No geocoding, radius logic, routing, database, filesystem, clock, provider, network or persistence.

invariants: manual approval required != manual approval granted
cancelled order + historical policy decision != revived order
deferred: policy decision persistence and global uniqueness/idempotency
FOOD-005M approved-fee to FOOD-005J charge binding

future.manualGate: A later readiness projection may require exact FOOD-005M approval only when an exact FOOD-005N decision says manual approval is required.
future.standardGate: When FOOD-005N says manual approval is not-required, later readiness may treat only that manual-approval requirement as satisfied. Every other readiness gate remains independent.
future.fees: FOOD-005N does not authorize or price a fee. FOOD-005M remains the positive manual approval record carrying approvedAdditionalFee when manual approval is required.
